records.name: Agility Pyramid fixed top payout and failure exposure

payout.unit: pyramid top sold to Simon Templeton
payout.type: fixed sale value; no loot-table roll after reaching the top

failure_and_attention.failure: Obstacles can fail below 75 Agility; a failed obstacle can deal up to 10 damage and reduces completed-top throughput.
failure_and_attention.failure_ceiling: At 75 Agility, no obstacle can fail.
failure_and_attention.desert_risk: Desert heat continues to require water or protection outside settlements.

community_guide_estimates.estimate: 200,000 coins per hour at 60+ Agility; up to 260,000 coins per hour at 75 Agility
community_guide_estimates.assumptions: Route efficiency, supplies, and obstacle success; lower levels can fail enough to materially reduce the rate.

records.name: Wealthy citizens and stealing valuables

mechanics.ordinary_pickpocket: Each successful wealthy-citizen pickpocket awards exactly 96 Thieving XP and 85 coins; outside a distraction, success and failure remain level-dependent.
mechanics.house_keys: Keys are variable loot at approximately 5/85 successful pickpockets. Full Rogue equipment doubles keys; a full inventory can suppress the key drop.
mechanics.distraction_window: Three street urchins distract citizens together every 84-99 seconds. During the approximately 20-24 second window, pickpockets have 100% success and continue automatically.
mechanics.valuables: Ordinary house searches award 45 Thieving XP and one valuable. A short-lived shiny-object event awards 14 valuables and 630 Thieving XP. Resale is fixed at 55 coins each to Oriana, or 65 coins each after the 8,000-Glory Fortis Colosseum Gladiator rank.
mechanics.caught_in_house: If the homeowner catches the player, about 90% of valuables from that house are lost; valuables obtained from earlier houses are retained.

attention_and_risk.attention: low-to-medium: street-urchin intervals support semi-AFK key collection, while house burgling needs monitoring for the return cue and window exit.
attention_and_risk.failure_risk: The deterministic sale price does not make total income deterministic: keys, house loot, jewellery, and catch losses vary.

side_outputs: easy clue scrolls from wealthy-citizen pickpockets
rare blessed bone statuettes that break into Prayer-training bone shards

community_guide_estimates.estimate: 1,600-2,300 valuables, or 90,000-125,000 coins per hour before Gladiator rank and excluding jewellery
community_guide_estimates.assumptions: 18-19 houses per hour and the guide's stated execution efficiency.

records.name: Giants' Foundry commission cash conversion

requirements.commission_inputs: Consumable metal bars or Smithing-made metal equipment worth at least two bars, plus a bucket or ice gloves to pick up the moulded weapon.

payout.type: fixed after the commission's final quality is determined
payout.coins: Twice the Smithing experience awarded for that completed sword.
payout.foundry_reputation: Equal to final sword quality: metal score plus mould score minus 5 per mistake.

attention_and_risk.risk: Input cost and the final quality/mistake count determine net GP; the coin formula is deterministic, but no single profit figure is independent of alloy choice, supplied item value, moulds, and execution.

side_outputs: Foundry Reputation for deterministic shop purchases and moulds

community_guide_estimates.estimate: 168,624 coins per hour for the listed forging-giant-swords method at 30 Smithing
community_guide_estimates.assumptions: The money-making guide's then-current inputs, quality, and execution; not an Ironman-guaranteed net rate.

records.name: Conventional stall thieving: silk sale cycle

requirements.location: a thievable silk stall, with East Ardougne providing the documented resale merchant

payout.unit: silk sold unnoted to the East Ardougne Silk Merchant after successful barter
payout.type: fixed merchant value after the theft cooldown; the number of successful steals is player-time dependent

attention_and_risk.attention: active stall clicking and guard/owner line-of-sight management
attention_and_risk.failure: A stall theft is 100% successful only while the owner and guards do not have line of sight. Being spotted causes guards to attack.
attention_and_risk.sale_delay: The merchant refuses recently stolen silk for roughly 20-30 minutes; time logged out does not count toward the owner interaction restriction.

side_outputs: silk is also a quest material

records.name: Blackjacking Pollnivneach bandits

requirements.quest_access: The Feud must be progressed far enough to use blackjacks; starting that quest requires 30 Thieving and its listed consumable coin requirement is 501 coins.

payout.coin_delivery: Coins are received directly from a knocked-out target rather than as coin pouches.

attention_and_risk.attention: high; repeated lure/knock-out/pickpocket inputs and fast recovery from failure
attention_and_risk.failure: Knock-out success is level-dependent and can fail. A failed knock-out can make the target aggressive and able to attack; the two pickpockets after a successful knock-out are guaranteed only when performed quickly.

side_outputs: Thieving experience: 65 per bearded bandit and 84.3 per bandit successful pickpocket

community_guide_estimates.estimate: 127,000 coins per hour at 50 Thieving and 220,000 coins per hour at 99 Thieving
community_guide_estimates.assumptions: The cited Ironman guide's click-intensive execution and stated equipment assumptions.

records.name: Sailing bounty-task coin payouts

payout.type: fixed for a completed accepted task
payout.coins: Equal to the task's base Sailing experience award.
payout.not_random_loot: The coin payout is not a reward-pool roll; it varies only because accepted tasks have different base experience.

attention_and_risk.attention: task-dependent active Sailing and travel; no universal GP-per-hour rate is a guaranteed mechanic.

side_outputs: bounty parts that cannot be banked but can be stored in a ship cargo hold

records.name: Sailing shipwreck salvaging

requirements.entry: Pandemonium completed; level 15 Sailing and a salvaging hook on a raft or better boat to begin.

mechanics.yield_type: Variable salvage is sorted into variable item loot; it is not a fixed coin payout.
mechanics.attention: low-intensity collection, but shipwrecks in an area share a limited spawn pool and sink after a timer once salvaging begins.
mechanics.station_effect: A salvaging station on the boat permits sorting at sea; without it, sorted loot requires a port station.

side_outputs: Sailing experience from retrieving and sorting salvage

community_guide_estimates.estimate: 21,610 coins per hour for small shipwrecks; 194,936 for large shipwrecks; 343,026 for mercenary shipwrecks
community_guide_estimates.assumptions: The Wiki money-making guides' loot valuation and activity assumptions. Higher wreck tiers impose additional level, boat, hook, and route gates.

records.name: Port Roberts non-depleting thieving stalls

mechanics.stock: The Port Roberts stalls do not deplete and continue stealing from one click.
mechanics.payout_type: Item output, not a fixed direct-coin reward; any shop sale or alchemy value depends on the selected stall and subsequent handling.
mechanics.arrest: Market guards patrol on fixed timings. Stealing while observed sends the player to jail; release is by lockpicking or a 500-coin bribe.

attention_and_risk.attention: active timing around guards; theoretical uninterrupted stall rates are reduced by guard behavior.

side_outputs: stall-specific supplies such as food, gems, ores, and cannonballs

records.name: Concrete cash commitments and cash-gated preparations

kingdom_coffer.entry: Throne of Miscellania seeds the coffer with a fixed 10,000 coins.
kingdom_coffer.classification: These coffer floors are formula thresholds for maximum daily wage, not quest-access requirements; daily payment is 10% of the current coffer up to the applicable cap.

initial_house_in_Rimmington.alternative: Daddy's Home grants the first house without the coin purchase

throne_of_miscellania_support.classification: Optional fixed-cost way to obtain the required 75% support; non-coin skilling alternatives exist.

the_feud.classification: Listed consumable coin preparation for the quest that enables blackjack progression.

rune_and_shop.Ali_Morrisane_rune_shop: Requires The Feud and Rogue Trader rune section; rune prices and stock are not represented as a fixed GP commitment.

Barrows_gloves.classification: Fixed purchase after Recipe for Disaster completion.

records.notes: This record names concrete spends, consumable gates, and formula thresholds only. It does not set a route cash target or prescribe a funding method.
